warnings: Character ratios and heuristic flags cannot guarantee mathematical formula accuracy or semantic correctness.
A page can pass every heuristic and still contain wrong or malformed formulas.
This audit performs text-layer extraction only; it does not perform OCR, formula recognition, or symbolic verification.
Pages with no Unicode Khmer are flagged for review; this heuristic may also flag legitimate math-only or non-Khmer pages.
Private-use characters are flagged when they make up at least 5% of non-whitespace characters.
The optional fontTools package is not installed; pypdf may not fully parse some CFF/Type1 fonts and may emit encoding warnings.

methodology.scope: Chapter 4 text extraction only; no OCR or formula verification
methodology.ratios: Reported over all extracted characters and over non-whitespace characters

corruption_heuristics.no_unicode_khmer: zero Unicode Khmer characters and at least 20 non-whitespace characters
